answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the bond, escalating linearly into real capital risk. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, held on-chain. Like a ridge holding back a lagoon prior to it reaches the ocean, the bond gate keeps cheap identities from swarming the economy, since honest peers verify stake and slash proven sybils, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
